items.quote: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
items.claim: Waters dried from the earth in the 601st year, 1st month, 1st day of the month; the ground became dry
items.action: removed the covering of the ark; looked
items.object: waters; covering of the ark; face of the ground
items.mechanism: waters dried up from the earth
